races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap Stakes (Whips To Be Carried, But Not Used) (Part Of Racing Excellence)

runners_data.name: Kimeko Glory
runners_data.note: Has course form at this trip and handles good ground well (sim-going 10/15), though her hold-up style means she needs the pace to collapse in front of her; Kyle McHugh takes a claiming partnership and she drops back from 10-12f runs, so the distance may suit better than recent form suggests.
runners_data.comment: Kimeko Glory has run over today's trip and going, rates 8 lb above her official mark on our figures, and a 15-day turnaround suggests she arrives fresh; the worry is she's winless in her last six starts, with a fourth the best she's managed recently.

runners_data.name: Sydney Rock
runners_data.note: Showed a placed effort on softer ground over 7f and good ground most recently at that trip; at 3yo carrying 135lbs she faces a fitness test off just 7 days, and her hold-up style means she needs traffic to clear, though she has the pace for a mile on this surface.
runners_data.comment: Sydney Rock returns just seven days on from a runner-up finish and has run over today's trip and going, giving her solid claims as the top-rated runner in this field; winless in her last five starts, she must convert placed efforts into something more, but the profile here is encouraging.

runners_data.name: Decalogue
runners_data.note: Jamie Osborne's 3yo has a modest recent profile (best recent finish 3rd over 8f on good) and is a genuine hold-up horse in profile — shuffled into a midfield map position simply because there is no room at the rear — so his chance is tempered by the likelihood he cannot settle into his natural rhythm in a steady-paced race.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Decalogue at least shaped with more promise last time, finishing third seven days ago, and he has experience of today's trip and going; carrying 134 lb from stall five, a career-best effort remains elusive but he merits respect.

runners_data.name: Thiscouldbefun
runners_data.note: The confirmed pace-setter for J S Moore, she is the race's structural fulcrum — if she gets her lead cheaply she can dictate throughout, and her placings on good-to-firm over a mile suggest the conditions are not a concern; the whips-carried-but-not-used restriction may slightly limit jockey Isobelle Chalmers' ability to galvanise her if challenged late.
runners_data.comment: Thiscouldbefun showed her best recent form with a third two starts back, and has run over today's trip and going — but she remains winless in her last five starts, which is the obvious concern.

runners_data.name: Zipwire
runners_data.note: Shaped with some promise in placings over 10f on good ground and is authentically a hold-up horse — slotted into midfield on the map as an overflow from the rear — meaning she is unlikely to get the strong end-to-end gallop she needs to finish off her run; the distance drop to a mile from 10f is untested for this season.
runners_data.comment: Zipwire showed real ability when winning and was placed second and third in recent starts, giving him a solid foundation at this trip and on today's going; the main concern is that he has been beaten in his last three outings.

runners_data.name: Amathus
runners_data.note: A 9yo veteran who won over 7f on good just recently (sim-going 12/15, 3 wins) and clearly loves the conditions, wearing a visor today; he is a natural hold-up horse mapped forward due to congestion, so the key question is whether he can navigate a clear run in the straight to utilise his proven finishing ability on this ground.
runners_data.comment: Amathus has experience of today's trip and going, and he did score last time out, but that single win sits amid a patchy recent record that has included finishes of eighth and ninth, and our figures rank him sixth of seven.

runners_data.name: Ebn Sabt
runners_data.note: Poor recent form figures (677078) and a sim-going record of just 2 placings from 14 outings suggest he struggles to translate ability onto fast ground; another true hold-up type forced into a midfield position, he looks the least likely to benefit from this race shape regardless of how it unfolds.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, with a string of mid-to-lower-order finishes, Ebn Sabt is hard to fancy ranked last of seven on our figures; he has run over today's trip and going before, and a nine-day turnaround at least suggests he arrives fresh.

races.paceDynamic: Thiscouldbefun is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with no genuine rival to dispute the lead, she is set to dictate from flag to finish at a controlled, sustainable gallop on good-to-firm ground over this flat mile at Salisbury. The tempo she sets will likely be steady to moderate — she will not be pressured early and can dictate the fractions, meaning the race will be run to suit those who can travel prominently and pounce from just off the pace rather than deep closers needing a strong end-to-end gallop to reel her in. The field holds substantially more hold-up horses than the pace map can accommodate at the rear — Decalogue, Zipwire, Amathus and Ebn Sabt are all genuine hold-up types redistributed toward midfield, meaning a cluttered mid-division is likely and genuine tracking positions behind the pace will be fiercely contested. The resulting shape — a solo leader at a measured clip with a congested midfield — firmly favours hold-up horses who can secure a clear passage and pick up late, but more immediately benefits any runner capable of tracking Thiscouldbefun closely from a prominent position and kicking off her back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Solo Leader Controls Race
scenarios.trigger: If Thiscouldbefun bowls into an uncontested lead and sets a steady-to-honest pace, controlling the fractions throughout.
scenarios.body: Thiscouldbefun dictates from a solo lead and the moderate tempo means she does not burn out her stamina reserves, giving her every chance to hold on through the final furlong; any hold-up horse forced to rattle home from deep in a slowly-run race is unlikely to generate enough momentum to reel her in.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves too steady and a hold-up horse secures clear daylight into the straight to pick off a tiring leader.
scenarios.body: A controlled gallop can paradoxically set up a finisher if the leader's stamina fades in the final 2f, opening the door for a well-positioned closer with a clean run; this shape demands both clear passage and a genuine finishing kick, which is harder to achieve with a congested midfield.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If a hold-up runner manages to track Thiscouldbefun closely throughout and times their challenge to perfection from just off the pace.
scenarios.body: A horse that avoids the mid-division traffic and slots in behind the leader gets the best of both worlds — cover early and a clear run late — but the redistribution of multiple hold-up types into midfield makes securing this tactical position genuinely difficult.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Collapses, Scrappy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the steady gallop suddenly quickens and a mid-division scramble produces a messy final furlong with no obvious beneficiary.
scenarios.body: With five horses crowded between midfield and hold-up positions, a traffic-heavy dash for home could produce a chaotic finish where a horse finding a gap late benefits from the carnage; this scenario is the least structured and most dependent on luck in running.

watchPoints.text: Thiscouldbefun sets the entire race shape — watch how quickly she establishes the lead and whether she is allowed to dictate a crawl, as any deceleration in the middle stages makes her harder to reel in for the hold-up brigade.

The mid-division is dangerously congested with Decalogue, Zipwire, Amathus and Ebn Sabt all compressed into the same area — watch for traffic issues entering the straight, particularly for Amathus who needs a clear passage to deploy his finishing kick.
Sydney Rock runs just 7 days after her last outing and carries 135lbs — watch for signs of sluggishness early that might indicate the quick turnaround has left her underprepared for this effort.

Amathus is the only runner in this field with a confirmed win at this type of going in recent form — watch whether Alfie Redman positions him closer than his natural style dictates to avoid being buried in traffic.

The whips-carried-but-not-used condition applies to all — watch for Thiscouldbefun in the final furlong if her lead is threatened, as Isobelle Chalmers cannot use the whip to galvanise her and must rely entirely on hands-and-heels riding to hold on.

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tiora Time
runners_data.note: Recent winner over 6f on Good and placed at 7f on Good, giving her the strongest form profile in the race; Colin Keane takes over and her close-tracking style means she is ideally positioned to exploit any late fade from Flooding.|

runners_data.name: All Angels
runners_data.note: Kieran Shoemark rides this Ed Walker hold-up filly who ran sixth on debut over 6f at Goodwood on Good — she needs this pace to be genuinely strong to land a blow from the rear, and that is unlikely with Flooding alone controlling fractions.|

runners_data.name: Flooding
runners_data.note: Marco Botti's filly ran second over 7f on Good and heads into this as the lone pace-setter; her STYLE_FIT flag tempers confidence slightly, but with no challenger for the lead, Murphy can set exactly the fractions he wants — a significant positional advantage.|

runners_data.name: Virtue Humble
runners_data.note: Jack Mitchell partners this Amanda Perrett newcomer-on-form whose single outing produced a 9th, her going suitability is unknown and she remains a complete unknown quantity — on bare form she asks the most questions.|

runners_data.name: Polgaria
runners_data.note: Roger Teal's filly has consecutive 8ths on Soft and Standard surfaces with a flagged tendency to fade in the finish; the step up to Good to Firm at Salisbury introduces further uncertainty, and her hold-up style in a slowly-run race is the least favourable scenario she could face.|

races.paceDynamic: Flooding is the lone confirmed front-runner in this five-runner fillies' novice and will set sail from the gates, gifting herself an uncontested lead through the opening stages of this 7f Salisbury contest on Good to Firm ground. With no other natural pace-setter to challenge her, the tempo is entirely in Oisin Murphy's hands — he can control the fractions and manufacture a race that plays to Flooding's strengths, though her STYLE_FIT flag (rated 0.90) acknowledges she is racing slightly out of her most natural role. The two hold-up fillies, All Angels and Polgaria, will be anchored at the rear, leaving Tiora Time as the only genuinely prominent type able to track and pressurise from close quarters. This shape — a single uncontested leader setting a comfortable, controllable pace with modest hold-up competition — distinctly favours the front-running or close-tracking profile, with true closers needing an unusually strong gallop to close the gap on this track.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Flooding Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Flooding leads comfortably at her own pace and Murphy controls the tempo throughout the 7f.
scenarios.body: Flooding establishes a rhythm from the front and, with no rival willing or able to challenge, produces a sustained effort into the Salisbury straight that is very hard to reel in; Tiora Time, tracking closely, is the main beneficiary if Flooding ties late, given her recent win form and similar-going record.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Flooding sets just enough pace to expose herself in the final furlong and Tiora Time sweeps past having tracked throughout.
scenarios.body: Tiora Time's 1-3 recent form over 6-7f on Good ground gives her the profile to sit a length or two off the pace and pounce; the relatively small field means she can travel comfortably without cover and pick off a tying leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Flooding sets a genuinely strong gallop that fades noticeably in the final 2f, opening the door for hold-up runners.
scenarios.body: All Angels or Polgaria would need a burning pace to generate enough momentum from the rear, and while All Angels showed only a single run (6th), her hold-up style suits a strong-run race; Polgaria's back-to-back 8ths and tendency to fade in finishes make this difficult to execute.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Entity Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Virtue Humble, despite her unknown going profile and single run of form, outclasses on raw ability.
scenarios.body: A lightly raced filly from Amanda Perrett's yard, Virtue Humble's true ceiling is unknown and a significant step forward from debut would be required; only a latent class advantage would bring this scenario to life.

watchPoints.text: Flooding's true front-running ability is uncontested here — if Murphy elects to roll along unchallenged from the start, no other runner has the tactical position to prevent her controlling the race entirely.
Tiora Time is the one horse who can physically sit on Flooding's shoulder throughout; if Colin Keane places her prominently from the gate, she becomes the most dangerous tactical threat in the race.

Polgaria's flagged tendency to fade in the finish is especially concerning on Good to Firm ground at 7f — back her only if you believe the pace will be strong enough to bring her into the race, which the race shape does not support.

All Angels is the most intriguing unknown — a single run does not expose her true ability, and if Ed Walker has her significantly improved, her hold-up style could produce a late surge, but this requires a pace scenario that looks unlikely.

The Going Report confirms Good to Firm for this 7f slot despite the headline card listing Good — faster ground will aid prominent types and front-runners more than hold-up fillies, reinforcing the race shape bias.

races.name: Colin Hinton & Mitch Hinton Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap Stakes (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Model Yuko
runners_data.note: Roger Varian's hold-up filly has a single win and place at this trip on comparable going, but her recent form is inconsistent (1-3-8-7-6) and she arrives 18 days fresh; best watched rather than relied upon in a genuinely run race.

runners_data.name: Green Sky
runners_data.note: Rod Millman's six-year-old is the standout on trip form — three successive wins over 12-14f on Good ground — and Oisin Murphy's booking is significant; she holds up naturally and this strongly-run 1m4f is exactly the race shape that exposes others' stamina limits in her favour.
runners_data.comment: Green Sky arrives in sparkling form, winning three of her last five starts, and she has experience over today's trip and conditions — the chief concern is whether 141 lb tests her stamina under that burden.

runners_data.name: Percy's Daydream
runners_data.note: David O'Meara's filly has been a model of consistency, placing in four of her last five at 10-12f on Good ground; Ben Coen takes over in the saddle and her prominent style suits a race where she can sit close to the duel without over-committing, though she has yet to win beyond a mile.
runners_data.comment: Percy's Daydream won four starts back and has experience of today's distance and going, while our rating of 93 marks her out as the one to beat at the head of the rankings — the risk is that she has finished fourth in three of her last four starts.

runners_data.name: Gloryous
runners_data.note: Jamie Osborne's front-runner will press for the lead from the off but her best form has come on Good ground over shorter (10f); returning from 33 days off and facing a rival in Counter Intuitive who matches her for pace, she may do the donkey work without reaping the reward.
runners_data.comment: Gloryous showed clear ability when third last time out and second four starts back, and has experience of today's going; winless in her last five, but our rating of 85 suggests she's capable of going one better.

runners_data.name: Counter Intuitive
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's three-year-old arrives on the back of back-to-back wins over 1m4f on Good ground and Kieran Shoemark continues in the saddle; she is the natural pace-setter and at only 129lbs she has a weight advantage, though a contested lead against Gloryous is the key risk to her stamina.
runners_data.comment: Counter Intuitive arrives in fine nick with back-to-back wins, yet her rating of 78 suggests she may be flattered by today's burden of 129 lb, and that inconsistent earlier form — sixth and eighth in her last four — tempers enthusiasm despite her experience over today's trip and going.

runners_data.name: Ruby Wedding
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's three-year-old won a Listed race over 11f on Good ground 19 days ago and apprentice Alfie Redman (7lb claim) is a significant help at the weights; her prominent style suits a race with genuine pace, and she has the profile to improve again at this longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time out and a winner two starts back, Ruby Wedding arrives in fine recent nick after just 19 days, has experience of today's trip and conditions, and her rating of 87 makes her our pick of the field despite not heading the official figures.

runners_data.name: Liveinthelight
runners_data.note: Ollie Sangster's filly has won three of her last four races and arrives in excellent form, but as a natural hold-up type she is unlikely to secure the midfield position shown on the map in a race this full of pace — her chance is tempered by racing further back than ideal, though the honest gallop does play to her staying strength if she can weave through.
runners_data.comment: Liveinthelight has winning form in recent starts — a winner two starts back and last time out — and she has experience of today's trip and conditions, but ranked sixth of seven on our figures, she faces a stiff ask against this field.

runners_data.name: Rossa Raheen
runners_data.note: Stablemate to Liveinthelight under the same Sangster roof, she has won once over 1m4f on Good ground recently but her true style means she will be racing from further back than the map suggests; with a lower OR of 73 and likely to be outpaced in the closing stages by classier rivals, she needs everything to fall perfectly.
runners_data.comment: Rossa Raheen won last time out and has experience of today's distance and going, but four unproductive efforts before that latest success leave her ranked last on our figures, making her hard to recommend at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Counter Intuitive and Gloryous are the two confirmed front-runners, and with both handlers likely to press for the lead from the off, this 1m4f contest on Good to Firm ground at Salisbury will be run at an honest, competitive gallop rather than a dawdle. Counter Intuitive has won twice in a row over this trip and Gloryous is a resolute pace-setter who won't concede without a fight, meaning the early splits should be genuine and the race will be strung out sooner than rivals might prefer. Percy's Daydream and Ruby Wedding will press from a prominent position just behind the duel, with Green Sky, Model Yuko and the redistributed pair tracking further back. This race shape — a genuinely contested pace over a staying trip on fast ground — strongly favours horses with proven stamina who can travel smoothly in midfield and produce a sustained late run, rather than those needing to be produced with one sharp burst; prominent racers who can sit just off the duel without over-committing are also well-placed. The field contains more genuine hold-up horses than the rear of the map can accommodate — Liveinthelight and Rossa Raheen, both natural hold-up types, are mapped to midfield positions they are unlikely to naturally secure given the pace in this field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest pace, stayers prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Counter Intuitive and Gloryous push each other along at a genuine gallop and the race is run at even splits throughout.
scenarios.body: The front pair drain each other's reserves by the home turn, leaving the race wide open for horses who have settled and travelled smoothly in the pack; a staying-oriented midfield or hold-up racer with strong recent form over this trip has the ideal platform.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pair outstay field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not truly gruelling and one of the front-runners — most likely Counter Intuitive — manages to control the tempo without overdoing it.
scenarios.body: Counter Intuitive's recent back-to-back wins over 1m4f on Good ground show she is well within her comfort zone; if Gloryous fades and she is left in front at a manageable speed, a horse who can sit within two lengths of the pace and quicken has the advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up types deliver late
scenarios.trigger: If the early duel between Counter Intuitive and Gloryous is fierce enough to collapse both of them entering the straight, creating a vacuum for runners tracking from off the pace.
scenarios.body: Green Sky is the form horse in this scenario having won three of her last four over 12-14f on Good ground, and Model Yuko carries proven ability at the trip; both have the profile to arrive late and powerfully through beaten rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical race, false pace
scenarios.trigger: If Gloryous concedes the front to Counter Intuitive early and the pace drops to a crawl, turning it into a sprint finish from the home turn.
scenarios.body: A compressed field in a slowly-run staying race rewards the horse with the sharpest turn of foot over the final two furlongs; Percy's Daydream's consistent prominent placing and Liveinthelight's recent winning form give them an edge in a race where position and quick acceleration matter most.

watchPoints.text: Counter Intuitive and Gloryous are on a collision course for the lead — watch how aggressively Kieran Shoemark and William Carson contest the early furlongs, as a fierce duel lasting beyond the halfway point will likely eliminate both from the finish.

Green Sky's price may be unrepresentative of her chance — three consecutive wins over 12-14f on Good ground and Oisin Murphy in the saddle make her a major player if the pace is genuinely contested, and she could drift in the market despite being well-suited.

Ruby Wedding's 7lb claimer Alfie Redman effectively drops her into the race on a competitive weight; watch whether she can secure a handy position from stall draw and whether Redman settles her early enough to produce her late run.

Liveinthelight and Rossa Raheen are both Ollie Sangster runners displaced further back than their natural style — watch whether either can find a gap through the field in the straight or whether the redistribution effectively neutralises their chance.

The going report confirms Good to Firm across all distances at Salisbury today — watch whether the faster-than-advertised surface (listed as Good to Firm, not Good as in the race card header) plays into the hands of horses with proven form on quick ground such as Green Sky and Percy's Daydream.

races.name: Venture Security Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Seven Sisters
runners_data.note: A hold-up filly for Ralph Beckett with smart form over 10 furlongs in Good going (1-2 record at the trip in similar conditions), but in an uncontested-pace scenario Edward Greatrex will struggle to manufacture the sectionals she needs; her best chance rests on the gallop being stronger than expected.
runners_data.comment: Seven Sisters won two starts back and was third three starts back, showing consistent recent form, and she has experience of today's trip and conditions; the main risk is her fourth-place finish last time out.

runners_data.name: Supplicate
runners_data.note: Roger Varian's filly has won three of her last four and is the lone front-runner in this small field, giving her a clear positional advantage; a STYLE_FIT tag reminds that she is rated as "prominent" rather than a true tearaway, but here she fills the lead role by default and that suits her record over the trip.
runners_data.comment: Supplicate has won her last three starts in a row and returns on a quick turnaround of 14 days, with experience over today's trip and going. However, our rating ranks her fifth of six, and a speed figure of 68 leaves her hard to fancy against stronger rivals.

runners_data.name: Sudbury Hill
runners_data.note: Headgear (p) worn for the first time is worth noting for Harry Derham's gelding, and his record includes wins over 10 and 17 furlongs on Good ground; his last run over this 1m2f trip resulted in a finishing position of 12, and he arrives as a genuine hold-up type who needs an honest gallop to land his best blow.
runners_data.comment: Sudbury Hill arrives on the back of a win last time out and has experience of both today's trip and going, making him a strong contender from stall 3 carrying 132 lb; the main risk is that his two prior starts show an unplaced effort sandwiched between placings, hinting at inconsistency.

runners_data.name: Akho Mezzna
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy takes the ride for Jack Jones and Akho Mezzna has placed twice over 10 furlongs in similar going, making her the most naturally suited to tracking Supplicate; headgear (b) worn and a STYLE_FIT note applies, but she is the prominent runner most likely to be genuinely close to the pace rather than shuffled back.
runners_data.comment: Consecutive seconds two and three starts back highlight Akho Mezzna's consistency at this level, and he returns after just 19 days with experience of today's trip and conditions working in his favour; winless in recent starts, but the 131 lb burden from stall four is the only mild query.

runners_data.name: On The Inlet
runners_data.note: Dr Newland & Insole's three-year-old is a true hold-up type whose best form has come over 7-8 furlongs on Standard surfaces — the step up to 1m2f on turf is an unknown, and the redistribution places him in midfield on the map despite a natural rear-of-field disposition; Ebrahim Nader faces a difficult tactical task.
runners_data.comment: On The Inlet boasts back-to-back wins in his recent form and returns here in good order on 27 days' rest, with our rating of 82 giving him a solid case; third last time out keeps him in the picture, though he must prove he can recapture that earlier spark from stall six on 131 lb.

runners_data.name: Storm Point
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's gelding has won over 7-8 furlongs on soft and standard ground; his natural prominent style could not be accommodated on the map given the pace already present, meaning Kieran Shoemark may find himself having to make an uncomfortable positional decision early — racing out of role with a modest STYLE_FIT of 0.90.
runners_data.comment: Storm Point has won twice in his last five starts but those finishes of seventh and sixth sandwich a win and paint an inconsistent picture; ranked last on our figures here, he faces a stiff ask, though familiarity with today's going is a minor point in his favour.

races.paceDynamic: Supplicate is the confirmed front-runner here and, with no genuine challenger for the lead in a six-runner field, she should dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop over this 1m2f trip on Good to Firm ground. Akho Mezzna is a prominent-going type who may track but is unlikely to force a contested pace, meaning Supplicate can set her own fractions without being pressured. The hold-up contingent — Seven Sisters, Sudbury Hill, and the redistributed On The Inlet — will be relying on a strong enough pace to set up a meaningful late run, but an uncontested solo leader rarely generates that pressure. This race shape strongly favours a prominent or pace-pressing profile: a horse close to the action in the first half and able to quicken off a comfortable tempo, rather than a pure closer waiting on a pace that may never materialise.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Supplicate Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Supplicate slots into the lead without a rival forcing her pace and controls the tempo throughout.
scenarios.body: Supplicate sets a measured gallop and the hold-up horses never get the strong pace they need to reel her in; a horse tracking closely in second or third is best placed to pounce if she weakens late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Presser Swoops From Close
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent-tracking horse times its challenge perfectly as Supplicate's pace softens inside the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: The tempo, though steady, accumulates over 1m2f and Supplicate may not be able to sustain a sprint finish; a horse who has tracked within two lengths and quickens at the right moment takes the prize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closer Gets Lucky Break
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is fractionally stronger than expected and the hold-up horses get a true run into the home straight.
scenarios.body: Seven Sisters or Sudbury Hill, with recent form over the trip and in similar going, produce a sweeping late run; however this depends on a scenario that the pace map suggests is unlikely given Supplicate's uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Race Blown Apart By Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Point or On The Inlet force their way into the race prominently and create an uncharacteristically strong tempo.
scenarios.body: The contested gallop burns off Supplicate and opens the race up for a staying-type closer; Sudbury Hill, with wins over longer trips, would be the primary beneficiary but this shape requires runners to race well out of their natural roles.

watchPoints.text: Supplicate's ability to control the tempo unchallenged is the single biggest factor in this race — watch whether any rival forces her to quicken early, as any pressure on the lead transforms the race shape entirely.

Akho Mezzna (Oisin Murphy) is the one prominent type capable of sitting directly behind Supplicate; if she tracks within a length or two into the straight she becomes a serious danger to the leader inside the final furlong.

Sudbury Hill wears a hood for the first time — watch how he loads and settles in the early stages, as headgear debutants can be unpredictable and a change in behaviour could alter his position through the early part of the race.

On The Inlet and Storm Point are both racing out of their natural roles in this shape — watch for either jockey taking an aggressive, position-grabbing decision from the gate that would change the pace calculus for the whole field.

The going report confirms Good to Firm conditions throughout the evening at Salisbury — any drying in the final race could marginally favour the prominent horses over hold-up types if the surface quickens further.
